aggregation.mean: unweighted arithmetic mean across graph seeds
aggregation.sample_sd: sample standard deviation with denominator n-1

base_edges.definition: Recorded baseEdges for the validated saturated base graph.

base_mean_degree.definition: Twice recorded baseEdges divided by the recorded 20,011 live nodes.

candidate_mean_base_degree.definition: Arithmetic mean of candidate baseDegree before the prospective holder-to-relay edge.

candidate_pool_size.definition: Number of distinct rows in the graph's candidate audit; validated against candidatePool.

candidate_zero_exposure_count.definition: Candidate rows with calibration exposure exactly zero.

holder_pretreatment_degree.definition: Recorded holderPretreatmentDegree before saturation to the conditioned holder degree of 50.

holder_pretreatment_items.definition: Recorded holderPretreatmentItems before target placement and saturation.

original_neighbor_mean_degree.definition: Recorded mean degree of the holder's original neighbors before relay replacement.

primary_95_band_size.definition: Candidates satisfying u_7(d+1) >= 0.95 u_7(8), where u_7(q)=q min(1,7/(q-1)); the recorded flag is independently rechecked.

primary_band_zero_exposure_share.definition: Zero-exposure candidates in the primary 95% band divided by primary_95_band_size.

routeband_band_sampling_fraction.definition: The fixed 50 RouteBand selections divided by primary_95_band_size; this is a pool-coverage description, not a probability sample.

routeband_replacement_count.definition: RouteBand-selected nodes not flagged as incumbents; validated against finalChangedRelays.

routeband_selected_exposure_mean.definition: Mean recorded target-free calibration exposure across the 50 RouteBand-selected relays.

routeband_selected_incumbent_share.definition: RouteBand-selected nodes flagged as original incumbent relays divided by 50.

routeband_selected_post_degree_max.definition: Maximum postDegree among the graph's 50 RouteBand-selected relays.

routeband_selected_post_degree_mean.definition: Within-graph mean postDegree across exactly 50 RouteBand selection rows; postDegree is validated as candidate baseDegree plus one.

routeband_selected_post_degree_min.definition: Minimum postDegree among the graph's 50 RouteBand-selected relays.

routeband_selected_zero_exposure_share.definition: RouteBand selections with calibration exposure exactly zero divided by 50.

safety_prefilter_holder_count.definition: Recorded safetyPrefilterHolders count: live nodes with degree 1--49 whose every neighbor has degree greater than 3, before the deterministically ordered removal-safety checks. It is not a count of rejected holder attempts.

limitations: The evidence records only the holder prefilter population. It does not record how many earlier candidates failed the removal-component safety check, their identities or rejection reasons, or how many native attachment attempts saturated the chosen holder; safetyPrefilterHolders cannot recover those attempt counts.
Exposure is based on 400 target-free simulated calibration traces and is not deployed traffic exposure.
Candidate and selection feasibility is conditional on the fixed two-hop, 16-root construction, fanout 7, one degree-50 holder, and these two simulated graph families.
The diagnostics describe recorded graph and selection feasibility. They do not estimate latency, wall-clock runtime, packet bytes, energy, churn adaptation, or online replacement behavior.
Family summaries are unweighted graph-seed descriptions, not additional confirmatory estimands and not pooled across families.
note: Per graph feasibility diagnostics for the ten arm confirmation, 128 graphs per attachment family. family_summaries gives the mean, minimum and maximum of each metric and graph_records gives the per graph values behind them.
